approval_scope: Owner Australia concept: typical hat, Sydney Opera House, jumping battle with kangaroo. Preparatory assets only; no publication/integration approval.

registration.integration_note: Assets are NATIVE100, unlike prior360 art. In a legacy Costume group already scaling .277778, wrap these native paths with scale(3.6) so total scale is approximately1 (3.6*.277778=1.0000008); do not apply .277778 directly to native100 geometry. World props remain native100 outside face/glance transforms. No production face redraw.
registration.face_reference: reference/curious-rest-reference.svg exact literal paths; reference/face-reference.json and source-excerpts.md copied unchanged.
registration.canonical_rest_eyes: centres32/68 y38, width20 height28, y24..52; NOT earlier short-eye art
registration.shared_motion: Face and hat must receive the SAME scene transform about50,46 AND same existing glance alignment; hat behind existing eye/mouth groups. Static board gaze=0 only. Current Costumes/glance are siblings: sanctioned future integration must explicitly align hat without changing face geometry. No app implementation supplied.
registration.transform_order: translate(tx ty) translate(50 46) scale(scale*sx scale*sy) translate(-50 -46), applied in native100 world; then existing glance alignment equally for hat/face; eye rotation remains0.
registration.limits: ONLY exact curious-rest gaze0 static bounds proven here. Other expressions, gaze, blends, blink/show features not proven; do not assert all-expression/runtime fit. Animation states are static spec samples, not app observations.

input_policy.lock_scope: Whole fixed9s scene: discard tap/menu/doubletap, drag/petting, sensor reactions and idle scheduler. No interactions interrupt/restart/prolong the scene.
input_policy.start_gate: No start during active contact/drag/pet or another scene.
input_policy.release_gate: Pointer held at deadline must release/cancel before normal NEW pointerdown gestures resume.
always_available: IMMEDIATE mute using short gain ramp; visual may continue
hidden/visibilitychange/pagehide: stop/dispose audio, cancel timers and remove all scene artwork; identity face restore
input_policy.finish: Exact pre-scene plain Buddy, identity scene transform, no overlay/props/audio nodes/timers, then unlock. Do not change app face defaults.

beats.action: hat/Opera House/kangaroo crossfade in; Buddy scales and shifts left gently
Buddy larger level wobble/squash attempt; soft landing, recover
sheepish pause; optional existing blink only if independently fit-verified; no new expression geometry
exact plain; remain locked to deadline

layer_order: native Unicode kangaroo emoji world container, ty hop only
hat face-local with identical face/scene/glance alignment
EXISTING app face features; never redraw production eyes/mouth
australia_hop_duet.easing: monotone ease-in-out cubic between keyframes; NO spring/overshoot, rotation or cork swinging.
australia_hop_duet.prop_placement: Native100 world identity. Ivory Opera House x6..69 y80..98.4; native kangaroo emoji container x70..96 y42..88 at rest, translates ty0..-14 with unchanged track; actual glyph ink/device fit unverified. Neither follows face/glance.

reduced_motion.mode: Static placed face at scale.72 tx-12 ty0 with static hat/Opera House/kangaroo. Crossfade exact plain to this static composition .3..1.1; hold; crossfade back7.7..8.5. No interpolated position/scale, hops, wobble, squash or cork movement. Same9s lock/music.
reduced_motion.preferred_static_crossfade: Crossfade exact plain to fixed placed face+hat/props .3..1.1, hold, crossfade back7.7..8.5. Never duplicate production face features: integrate via existing rendering capability, not this board reference.
reduced_motion.music_lock_safety: same9s score, lock, input discard, release gate and always-immediate safety; no shortened duration

australia_hop_duet.neutral_start_end: at0 and9 no overlay/prop; scene face transform identity. At9 dispose audio and timers; no lingering nodes.

text_layout.font_stack: "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Noto Color Emoji", emoji
text_layout.align: horizontal center, bottom; world anchor centre83 bottom88
text_layout.container: 26x46 native units, flex align-items:flex-end; justify-content:center; no box rotation; overflow visible during verification; never crop glyph to hide bad fit

native_emoji_prop.motion: Apply unchanged prop:australia_kangaroo opacity/ty track to WHOLE WORLD container. Not face/glance-local. No flipped/copied paths or downloaded emoji image.
native_emoji_prop.reduced_motion: Static slot ty0 with existing crossfade timing0/.3/1.1/7.7/8.4/9, same music/lock; hidden/pagehide/exit removes text container/timers immediately.
native_emoji_prop.accessibility: Decorative aria-hidden=true; no focus, pointer-events:none, user-select:none; do not announce each hop. Any scene menu label is separate accessible UI.
native_emoji_prop.fit_limit: Slot bounds mathematical only. Actual native glyph ink/metrics/design vary by OS, font and phone. Font fallback and runtime fit UNVERIFIED; verify real device before integration acceptance. Do not solve overflow with clipping.
native_emoji_prop.board_only: System-installed Noto Color Emoji illustration; phone styles vary. No extracted glyph asset or font shipped.
